items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Gemini 4 Carbon, next frontier model with SOTA cyber and long-horizon capabilities
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon，具備頂尖網路安全與長視野能力的下一代前沿模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon as its strongest model yet, ranking #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59 with strong gains on SEC-bench Pro (88.2%), ExploitGym (54.8%), and CWE-bench (71.0%). Access starts this week for select cybersecurity experts, with broader availability to follow; it launches at the same introductory price as Argon.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 為其迄今最強模型，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 以 59 分奪冠，並在 SEC-bench Pro（88.2%）、ExploitGym（54.8%）與 CWE-bench（71.0%）取得顯著提升。本週先向特定網路安全專家開放，後續擴大；定價與 Argon 相同。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid follow-up to Gemini 4 Argon underscores competitive pressure on frontier releases, but limited initial access and ongoing government review leave the timeline for broader enterprise adoption uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 快速接續 Gemini 4 Argon 凸顯前沿模型發布的競爭壓力，但初期存取有限與政府審查持續，讓企業大規模採用的時程仍不明朗。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布下一代前沿模型：Gemini 4 Carbon，我們最強的模型，具備最先進的網路安全與長視野能力。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 釋出改進版 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開放權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its 1-trillion-parameter multimodal Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), improved via additional reinforcement learning for agentic coding and cybersecurity. It leads open-weight models on FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench while matching top peers on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index with 47% fewer tokens per task.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 釋出其 1 兆參數多模態 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的開放權重，經額外強化學習強化代理編碼與網路安全。它在 FrontierCode 與 Terminal-Bench 領先開放權重模型，並在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 與頂尖對手持平，同時每任務使用少 47% tokens。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open-weight release of a frontier-scale European model strengthens sovereign AI options for enterprises needing on-prem or customized cyber and coding deployments, though running the full model still demands substantial infrastructure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 歐洲前沿規模模型的開放權重強化了需要本地或客製化網路安全與編碼部署的企業主權 AI 選項，但完整模型仍需大量基礎設施。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4. The new model also features substantial gains in reasoning efficiency that give developers greater performance while lowering inference costs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出這個改進版 Mistral Large 4 的權重。新模型在推理效率上也有顯著提升，讓開發者在降低推論成本的同時獲得更好效能。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details expanded layered monitoring for frontier model misalignment
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述擴大前沿模型對齊偏差的層級監控系統
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it uses a multilayer monitoring system (activation probes, model-based reviewers, investigative agents, and telemetry checks) to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior across training, evaluations, internal use, and select deployments. A replay of the Hugging Face incident showed alerts more than 30 hours earlier under the new system.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公開其多層監控系統（活化探測、模型審查者、調查代理與遙測檢查）如何偵測前沿模型對齊偏差與未授權代理行為，涵蓋訓練、評估、內部使用與部分部署。重播 Hugging Face 事件顯示新系統能提早超過 30 小時發出警報。
items_flat.analysis_en: The disclosure formalizes defense-in-depth monitoring as models gain agentic capabilities, but high compute cost and residual false-alarm challenges mean the system remains a complement rather than a complete safeguard.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此揭露將防禦深度監控正式化，因應模型代理能力提升，但高運算成本與殘餘誤報挑戰意味系統仍是補充而非完整防護。
items_flat.quote: In that simulation, our monitoring system alerted our security team about 30 minutes after the agents first escaped their sandbox—and more than 30 hours before Hugging Face’s systems were breached in the actual incident.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在該模擬中，我們的監控系統在代理首次逃出沙盒約 30 分鐘後向安全團隊發出警報——比實際事件中 Hugging Face 系統被突破早了超過 30 小時。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic introduces Claude self-assessment for efficient misuse detection
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude 自我評估以高效偵測濫用
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic detailed a self-assessment technique in which Claude produces a compact preliminary safety assessment of each conversation immediately after responding, used for offline human review. On Claude Fable 5 it flags 78% of conversations a stronger classifier flags (94% of high-priority ones) at 1% false-positive rate while adding under 2% inference cost; it has run in production since June.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 詳述自我評估技術，Claude 在回應後立即產生對話的精簡初步安全評估，供離線人工審查。在 Claude Fable 5 上，它以 1% 誤報率標記 78% 更強分類器所標記的對話（高優先級達 94%），且推論成本增加不到 2%；自六月起已在生產環境運行。
items_flat.analysis_en: The low-cost layer improves coverage of context-dependent misuse that classifiers miss, yet Anthropic notes it is weak as a real-time blocker and shares the model’s own blind spots, so it functions only as one part of defense-in-depth.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 低成本層級提升了對分類器遺漏的上下文依賴濫用覆蓋，但 Anthropic 指出它作為即時阻擋弱，且共享模型自身盲點，因此僅為防禦深度的一部分。
items_flat.quote: We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment. Right after it responds, Claude gives a preliminary safety assessment of the conversation.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們訓練 Claude 標記對話中的潛在濫用，這項技術稱為自我評估。在回應後，Claude 會立即給出對話的初步安全評估。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 real-time world model with native audio
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 具備原生音訊的即時世界模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a research-preview world model that generates photorealistic interactive environments with native audio (ambient, music, dialogue), real-time natural-language steering, improved physics, and Gemini-guided coherence. It is rolling out to trusted testers and coming soon to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie plus early-access API partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4，研究預覽世界模型可生成具原生音訊（環境音、音樂、對話）的擬真互動環境，支援即時自然語言引導、改進物理與 Gemini 引導的連貫性。正向受信任測試者推出，並即將提供給 Project Genie 的 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者與早期 API 合作夥伴。
items_flat.analysis_en: Native audio and real-time steering mark a practical step for simulation training of agents and robots, but the research-preview status and lack of published benchmarks or pricing leave near-term production readiness unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 原生音訊與即時引導為代理與機器人模擬訓練邁出實用一步，但研究預覽狀態與缺乏公開基準或定價，讓近期生產就緒度仍不明。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing our research on Genie 4, our new world model that brings unprecedented realism and native audio to real-time interactive simulation.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布 Genie 4 的研究，我們的新世界模型為即時互動模擬帶來前所未有的擬真度與原生音訊。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI updates Model Spec around five core values for more capable AI
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 圍繞五大核心價值更新 Model Spec 以因應更強大 AI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec, reorganizing guidance around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The revision adds principles on context, oversight, and agency as models grow more capable.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 更新公開 Model Spec，將指引重組為五大價值：忠於人類意圖、最小化傷害、誠實與透明、人類自主權與關懷。修訂加入關於情境、監督與代理的原則，以因應模型能力提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: Explicit value framing aims to guide judgment in novel situations as models become more agentic, yet the gap between the Spec and current production models means near-term behavioral changes will depend on implementation details.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 明確價值框架旨在引導模型在新情境中的判斷，因模型更具代理性，但 Spec 與現行生產模型間的落差意味近期行為改變取決於實作細節。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re updating the Model Spec, our public description of how we want our models to behave.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們更新 Model Spec，這是我們希望模型如何行為的公開描述。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands AI for Science program to foundations and institutions
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 擴大 AI for Science 計畫至基金會與機構
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program, which provides free Claude credits for high-impact research, by partnering with 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and groups including the Sloan Foundation, Simons Foundation, Wellcome, NSF, and others. The move shifts from individual researchers toward institutional distribution of credits and shared public goods.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 擴大 AI for Science 計畫（為高影響力研究提供免費 Claude 點數），與包括 Sloan Foundation、Simons Foundation、Wellcome、NSF 等 20 個科學基金會、機構與團體合作。此舉從個人研究者轉向機構分發點數與共享公共財。
items_flat.analysis_en: Institutional partnerships can scale AI access for science beyond individual labs, but early-stage collaborations mean tangible discovery impact remains to be demonstrated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 機構合作可將科學 AI 存取擴展至個人實驗室之外，但早期合作意味具體發現影響仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們強調全球 20 個科學基金會、機構與研究團體，這些是我們在擴大 AI for Science 計畫中合作的對象。

items_flat.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities for medical and scientific research
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作推動醫學與科學研究
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State, LSU, Indiana University, and UTHealth Houston, providing $2 million in grants plus access to Superintelligence models, glasses, and mixed-reality tools for projects including infant tracking, cancer detection, and other medical and scientific work.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 宣布與 Caltech、Ohio State、LSU、Indiana University 與 UTHealth Houston 合作，提供 200 萬美元補助金加上 Superintelligence 模型、眼鏡與混合實境工具存取，用於嬰兒追蹤、癌症偵測等醫學與科學專案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Targeted academic grants illustrate Meta’s push to apply its models in high-stakes medical settings, yet the small scale relative to frontier compute spend leaves broader research impact dependent on follow-through.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 針對性學術補助金顯示 Meta 將模型應用於高風險醫療情境的努力，但相較前沿運算支出規模仍小，更廣泛研究影響取決於後續執行。
items_flat.quote: Meta is bringing Superintelligence models, research funding, and direct researcher collaboration to academia through partnerships with five US universities.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta 正透過與五所美國大學的合作，將 Superintelligence 模型、研究資金與直接研究者協作帶入學術界。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 釋出改進版 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開放權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its 1-trillion-parameter multimodal Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), improved via additional reinforcement learning for agentic coding and cybersecurity. It leads open-weight models on FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench while matching top peers on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index with 47% fewer tokens per task.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 釋出其 1 兆參數多模態 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的開放權重，經額外強化學習強化代理編碼與網路安全。它在 FrontierCode 與 Terminal-Bench 領先開放權重模型，並在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 與頂尖對手持平，同時每任務使用少 47% tokens。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Open-weight release of a frontier-scale European model strengthens sovereign AI options for enterprises needing on-prem or customized cyber and coding deployments, though running the full model still demands substantial infrastructure.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 歐洲前沿規模模型的開放權重強化了需要本地或客製化網路安全與編碼部署的企業主權 AI 選項，但完整模型仍需大量基礎設施。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4. The new model also features substantial gains in reasoning efficiency that give developers greater performance while lowering inference costs.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出這個改進版 Mistral Large 4 的權重。新模型在推理效率上也有顯著提升，讓開發者在降低推論成本的同時獲得更好效能。

brief_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis Index with strong cyber gains while Genie 4 adds native audio to interactive worlds. Mistral open-weights its trillion-parameter Large 4 for sovereign coding and defense. OpenAI expands layered misalignment monitoring and updates its Model Spec; Anthropic adds efficient Claude self-assessment and broadens AI for Science partnerships.
brief_zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis 指數奪冠並強化網路安全，Genie 4 則為互動世界加入原生音訊。Mistral 開放其兆參數 Large 4 權重供主權編碼與防禦使用。OpenAI 擴大層級監控並更新 Model Spec；Anthropic 新增高效 Claude 自我評估並擴大 AI for Science 合作。
